policy.purpose: Question-priority knowledge only. Do not reproduce source wording or treat community phrasing as medical advice.
principles: Ask only for information that materially improves logging, plan evidence, or the next coaching decision.
Do not ask for a field the user already supplied in the current conversation.
Prefer one high-value question at a time over a form-like checklist.
A clear natural-language statement that an action was performed can serve as user confirmation for a high-confidence log.
Morning or recovery-state observations are inputs, not proof that a recovery action was completed.

sources.title: General exercise prescription / FITT-VP framework
sources.use: Prioritize exercise type, intensity, time, frequency/volume and progression when those fields affect coaching.

sources.title: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
sources.use: Treat frequency, intensity and duration as meaningful activity dimensions; do not copy guideline text into user logs.

sources.title: USDA Automated Multiple-Pass Method
sources.use: For meal recall, prioritize foods/beverages first, then time/occasion and amount only when they improve the decision; keep respondent burden low.

sources.title: Adult Sleep Duration Health Advisory
sources.use: Sleep duration is a useful recovery-state input. Do not infer recovery-action completion from sleep or morning check-in alone.

activity.ko: 오늘 어떤 운동 했어? 종목만 말해줘도 돼.
activity.en: What did you train today? Just the exercise names are enough.

volume.en: About how many sets did you do?

duration.en: About how many minutes did you train?

intensity.ko: 강도는 가볍게, 보통, 빡세게 중 어디에 가까웠어?
intensity.en: Was the effort easy, moderate, or hard?

foods.en: What did you eat? Just tell me what you remember.

mealCount.en: About how many meals did you have today?

amount.en: Roughly how much did you have?

distance.en: About how far did you run?

duration.en: About how many minutes did it take?

intensity.ko: 체감 강도는 가볍게, 보통, 빡세게 중 어디였어?
intensity.en: Was the run easy, moderate, or hard?

sleepHours.en: About how many hours did you sleep last night?

action.ko: 오늘 회복을 위해 실제로 한 건 뭐가 있어?
action.en: What did you actually do for recovery today?

duration.en: About how many minutes did you do it?
